findings.title: Demand certificate proposal metadata names the validation anchor
findings.description: The DEMAND_FEATURE certificate entry uses demand_basis[2], validation.ref_s34_id, as attributes.proposal_id. In the full profile this is N, while the demand row physically references F via demand_basis[3]. Independent inspection confirms the authoritative _progress_sources and _verify_full_progress reconstruction checks D.ref_s34_id=F, N.demand_feature_id=D, both action proposals and exact hashes. This metadata is not a guard input or evidence of action applicability; dependency identity/revision, closure digest and finite bounds remain correct. It therefore does not permit an invalid authorization, but the audit field is misleading.
findings.requested_action: Track a separately scoped correction or clarification of the audit attribute and verify it against the physical demand-to-F link. The task result already declares a separate follow-up; do not silently alter this reviewed revision.
